duchess_wood.heard: Playful clarinet, accordion, tuba, and light percussion in a fast, bouncy polka-style rhythm; cheerful and mischievous mood.
duchess_wood.issues: Not a waltz (3/4), missing harpsichord, and has a definitive ending instead of a seamless loop.

queens_garden.heard: Synthesized brass, snare drum, harpsichord, strings, and flute at an upbeat march tempo; grand, regal, and comical retro game mood softening into a gentle outro.
queens_garden.issues: The track does not loop seamlessly; it starts with a distinct fanfare and cuts off during a quiet string section at the end.

rabbit_hole.heard: Harpsichord, flute, strings, pizzicato bass, and harp playing a cheerful pastoral melody at around 90 BPM that shifts to a slower, quiet harp and string section at the end.
rabbit_hole.issues: Not a seamless loop; the track stops at 0:24 and plays a separate, slower ending cue.

rabbit_house.heard: 16-bit retro RPG style with jaunty clarinet, oboe, bassoon, and harpsichord at a moderate tempo, whimsical and cosy mood.
rabbit_house.issues: abrupt ending, missing the transition to sitar-like chiptune, does not loop seamlessly

title.heard: Harpsichord, celesta, flute/woodwinds, plucked strings, in a gentle 3/4 waltz around 96 BPM with a nostalgic, cosy 16-bit RPG storybook mood.
